items.html:
Glen Sulzberger started as a specialist left-hand batsman (he was originally a medium-pacer but was forced to give that up when he sustained a back injury) who developed his offspin to such an extent that he won selection for New Zealand as a genuine allrounder. A successful A-team tour of England brought him to the attention of the selectors, and although he disappointed he was recalled following another good A-team tour of India.
Martin Williamson
